g.title: G
g.text: After Stop() makes run() return (it closes n.done), a later Status() call sends its request on n.status.
Nobody receives it any more, so that goroutine leaks.
• c (reply, run): a send exists but no goroutine ever receives from it
• c (reply, Status): a receive exists but no goroutine ever sends on it
• a channel is passed as a value: dingo-hunter loses the alias, so a reply channel can show up as two channels (the red
⚠ marks on them are a tool artefact)

g.title: legend
g.text: (channel relay machines 0–4 omitted from the drawing)
= STOP message. Bold circle = start state, double circle = end state, numbers in machines = machine ids.
